title: Volcanoes
blurb: Lava, eruptions, geysers, and mountains made of fire.

hr.title: Vulkani
hr.blurb: Lava, erupcije, gejziri i planine od vatre.

questions.q: What is the largest active volcano on Earth?
questions.fact: Measured from its base on the seafloor, Mauna Loa in Hawaii is about 17 km (56,000 ft) tall.

hr.q: Koji je najveći aktivni vulkan na Zemlji?
hr.fact: Mjereno od podnožja na morskom dnu, Mauna Loa na Havajima visoka je oko 17 kilometara.

questions.q: Which volcano started growing in a Mexican cornfield in 1943?
questions.fact: Parícutin erupted for nine years. Scientists got to watch a brand-new volcano grow from the very start.

hr.q: Koji je vulkan 1943. počeo rasti usred kukuruznog polja u Meksiku?
hr.fact: Parícutin je izbacivao lavu devet godina. Znanstvenici su mogli gledati kako novi vulkan raste od samog početka.

questions.q: What do we call melted rock after it pours out onto the ground?
questions.fact: While it is still underground, melted rock is called magma.

hr.q: Kako zovemo rastaljenu stijenu kad izađe na površinu?
hr.fact: Dok je još pod zemljom, rastaljena stijena zove se magma.

questions.q: The Ring of Fire circles which ocean?
questions.fact: The Ring of Fire is a horseshoe-shaped chain of volcanoes about 25,000 miles long.

hr.fact: Vatreni prsten je lanac vulkana u obliku potkove, dug oko 40.000 kilometara.

questions.q: About what share of the world's volcanoes are in the Ring of Fire?
questions.fact: About three out of every four volcanoes on Earth sit along the Ring of Fire.

hr.q: Otprilike koliki je dio svjetskih vulkana u Vatrenom prstenu?
hr.fact: Otprilike tri od svaka četiri vulkana na Zemlji nalaze se duž Vatrenog prstena.

questions.q: Old Faithful geyser is in which national park?
questions.fact: Old Faithful got its name in 1870 because it erupted so regularly.

hr.q: U kojem je nacionalnom parku gejzir Old Faithful?
hr.fact: Old Faithful (Stari vjerni) dobio je ime 1870. jer je izbijao tako redovito.

questions.q: What heats the water in Yellowstone's geysers?
questions.fact: Heat from the volcano deep under Yellowstone warms the water that shoots out of its geysers.

hr.q: Što grije vodu u gejzirima Yellowstonea?
hr.fact: Toplina vulkana duboko pod Yellowstoneom grije vodu koja šiklja iz gejzira.

questions.q: Which ancient Roman town was buried by ash from Mount Vesuvius?
questions.fact: The ash kept Pompeii so well that today you can walk its streets and see old shops and wall paintings.

hr.q: Koji je drevni rimski grad zatrpao pepeo s Vezuva?
hr.fact: Pepeo je Pompeje sačuvao tako dobro da se i danas može šetati njihovim ulicama i vidjeti stare trgovine i zidne slike.

questions.q: A wide volcano with gentle slopes, like Mauna Loa, is what type?
questions.fact: Mauna Loa means Long Mountain in Hawaiian. Its broad shape looks like a warrior's shield lying down.

hr.q: Širok vulkan blagih padina, poput Mauna Loe, koje je vrste?
hr.fact: Mauna Loa na havajskom znači Duga planina. Svojim širokim oblikom podsjeća na ratnički štit položen na tlo.

questions.q: True or false: Fresh lava can be hotter than 1,000°C.
questions.fact: Lava in Hawaii comes out at about 1,150°C (2,100°F), hot enough to glow orange-red.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: svježa lava može biti vruća više od 1.000 °C.
hr.fact: Lava na Havajima izlazi s oko 1.150 °C, dovoljno vruća da svijetli narančasto-crveno.
